name: עֻזִּיאֵל
summary: Above all Uzziel son of Kohath, brother of Amram and so uncle of Aaron and Moses (Exo 6:18), whose sons Mishael and Elzaphan carried Nadab and Abihu out of the camp (Lev 10:4); his descendants were the Uzzielite clan of the Kohathites (Num 3:27, 30; 1Ch 15:10; 26:23). The name is also borne by a captain of Simeon who went to Mount Seir (1Ch 4:42), a son of Bela of Benjamin (1Ch 7:7), a son of Heman among the singers (1Ch 25:4, Azarel in 25:18), a son of Jeduthun in Hezekiah's days (2Ch 29:14), and Uzziel son of Harhaiah, a goldsmith who repaired the wall (Neh 3:8). The name is עֻזִּי “my strength” with אֵל “God”: “God is my strength”, as “God is to us a refuge and strength” (Psa 46:2).

evidence.note: “The sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar and Hebron וְעֻזִּיאֵל.”
“The sons of Uzziel: Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri.”
“Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron.”
A Simeonite: “Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah וְעֻזִּיאֵל, the sons of Ishi.”
A son of Heman; the same singer is עֲזַרְאֵל in 1Ch 25:18.
“Of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah וְעֻזִּיאֵל.”
“Uzziel son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths, repaired.”
“God (אֱלֹהִים) is to us a refuge and עֹז.”

note: Takes p.bx.ak (the name, 16 tokens) and p.bx.al (the gentilic עָזִּיאֵלִי, Num 3:27; 1Ch 26:23), which TIPNR files under Uzziel@Exo.6.18. BDB's (וְ)יַעֲזִיאֵל (p.bx.ap, 1Ch 15:18, 20), perhaps a copying slip for this name, is not claimed. The reading “God is my strength” is a reading of the form; scripture does not explain the name. Azarel (1Ch 25:18, of עזר) is not claimed.
